assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel art sprite sheet for Drowned videogame, 6 columns and 5 rows, exactly 30 separate poses in evenly spaced cells. Primary request: Afogado Pesado, a heavy drowned zombie enemy distinct from the small navy-uniform zombie. A squat hulking sea-green zombie with huge bare forearms and fists, a small bald head, torn brown dockworker vest, dark navy trousers and iron ankle chains. Side/three-quarter view facing right. Broad compact silhouette, hunched shoulders, pale cyan eyes. Style: SIMPLE classic low-resolution pixel art designed for 64x64 pixels per pose, large clean pixel clusters, dark one-pixel outline, at most 12 flat colors, no tiny texture details, no gradients or blur. Every character occupies approximately 80% of its identical cell. Row 1 exactly 6 breathing idle poses. Row 2 exactly 6 walking poses alternating legs. Row 3 exactly 6 heavy overhead fist smash poses: crouch, wind up, raised arms, slam, follow-through, recover. Row 4 exactly 6 recoil/recovery hurt poses. Row 5 exactly 6 death poses, falls then lies on ground. SAME individual, same proportions and palette in all 30 cells. Fully transparent RGBA background and wide empty transparent gutters between all cells. Entire characters/arms fit INSIDE each cell, identical scale, aligned feet within each row, no neighboring cell overlap. No labels, no text, no grid lines, no props outside the character, no light effects, no floor or shadows.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel art sprite sheet for Drowned first boss, exactly 6 columns by 5 rows with 30 clearly separated poses in evenly spaced cells. Primary request: Guardião Abissal, an enormous monstrous drowned zombie, a truly different creature silhouette, not a scaled-up ordinary sailor. Huge hunched blue-green undead sea monster with disproportionately long massive arms, a broad jaw opening to roar, a small sunken skull, jagged dark stone/coral growing from shoulders and upper back, torn dark cloth at waist, short thick legs, pale cyan eyes. No weapons. Heavy asymmetrical organic silhouette recognizable from far away. Side/three-quarter view facing right, whole body visible. Style: SIMPLE classic pixel-art suited to 64x64 logical pixels per cell, chunky flat clusters, dark thick outline, max 12 flat muted colors, no detailed painted shading, gradients, glows, atmospheric effects or fine texture. Row 1 exactly 6 breathing idle poses. Row 2 exactly 6 lumbering walk poses with alternating legs. Row 3 exactly 6 roar-and-slam attack poses: crouch, raise head, wide open roaring jaw with arms raised, slam fists, follow-through, recover. Row 4 exactly 6 hurt/recovery poses. Row 5 exactly 6 dying/collapsing poses ending on ground. SAME creature, proportions, clothing and palette across all 30 cells. Equal scale and aligned feet within rows. Real transparent RGBA background, wide empty transparent gutters around EVERY pose. Whole bodies and arms stay inside their own cells. No labels, lettering, grid lines, scenery, floor shadows, extra characters, particle effects or detached pieces.
assets.refinement_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached 6x5 sprite sheet. Remove the entire dark teal gradient background and all haze/glow between and behind poses, replace with TRUE RGBA alpha transparency (alpha 0). Preserve exactly all 30 monstrous zombie sprite poses, their pixel silhouettes, color and positions, row/column layout and proportions; do not add, delete, merge, or move any creatures. Every inter-cell gutter and all space outside the creature outlines must be fully transparent, not dark colored. Also keep the sprites crisp, no semitransparent edge glow. Return the sheet with transparent background, no checkerboard painted into pixels.
